text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by an arcade—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Uuuu~, it dropped again...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I have to operate it way more carefully,
and aim right for the center...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~ this isn't my strong suit! But I'm not giving up yet...!
Please wait just a bit longer, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No... it's fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh, but... that blue cushion,
you seemed quite interested in it earlier, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not 'quite'... 
I was just curious about how it felt to the touch, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then I'll win it for you,
so we can check how it feels together!!
All right...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, ...good grief.

Narita Top Road was attempting a crane game,
aiming for a pale blue cushion that looked somehow very soft to touch. However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh! Again...!!
Ah, jeez, why am I always so clumsy with these things...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ayabe-san, I'm sorry!
I'll go get some change—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It really is fine, Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you told before as well?
'You don't have to push yourself so hard.'

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for trying to win it for me.
I appreciate the sentiment. ...So please, enough—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Hearing everyone and you say that to me
makes me very happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But still, after all—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's precisely why I want
to give my best for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of someone as kind
as you, who would say such words!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You really are... something else...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um! It might be selfish of me, but...
Could you try having some 'expectations' of me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Expectations?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For me, that works the absolute best.
...Would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I think you'll get it next time.
...If it's you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
!!
Yes, I'll definitely do it!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting...!!
Here you go, Ayabe-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Your 'expectations'
gave me so much strength!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hu-huh!?
The one next to it fell down instead...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That one is fine too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It looks... pretty fluffy, after all.
